desc:
Note: Lootbound is intended to be played in lobbies of 3 - 4 players but supports 1 - 6 players, difficulty increases with relation to party size.

Embark on an epic adventure, fighting back against the corruption spreading across the world.

🗺️ Journey through handcrafted dungeons inspired by real locations
⚔️ Unlock powerful skills to help you on your adventure
💎 Discover rare weapons and armor 
🏹 Strengthen your character and rise through increasingly difficult challenges
🫂 Join forces with friends or brave the dungeons on your own

Join the group for 10% extra EXP and Coins.
Like and Favorite for 5% extra EXP and Coins.
